ICC Announces 2027 ODI World Cup Schedule

The International Cricket Council (ICC) has announced the schedule for the 2027 ODI World Cup. The schedule includes India's fixtures and the highly anticipated match between India and Pakistan. Specific dates and venues for the tournament have also been released.
